_vehicle: F-16 (NASA equations model) flown by the DYNAMIC-INVERSION controller (src_DI, bin/DI). Pairs with Flight-Simulator physics input_files/F16input.json. Vehicle geometry/inertia/aero below are copied verbatim from that physics file so the model the inversion uses matches the plant. Double-precision UDP: receives the 22-field 'both' state on 5001, sends 4 controls [da,de,dr,throttle] on 5002 (entity_tagged:false, matching the physics connection).
_method_note: NDI = full-model inversion, needs no EKF (the F16 physics has no sensor/EKF block). For INDI you would set indi.omega_dot_source and append pdot/qdot/rdot to packet_order, which this F16 physics does not output — so keep method=ndi.

udp.entity_tagged_notes: MUST match the physics controller_send/controller_receive entity_tagged. F16input.json uses false.
udp.packet_order_notes: 22-field double 'both' packet: state + commanded controls + actual surfaces. da/de/dr (actual) are the INDI baseline; unused by NDI but harmless.

pilot_inputs.csv_file_notes: only used when type==csv; ignored in udp (gamepad) mode.

modes.notes: Xbox: A=velocity, B=angles, X=rates, Y=altitude, RB=sideslip. angles/altitude use the DI outer attitude loop; rates feeds the rate loops directly. NOTE: F16input.json starts the plant in an SCT trim (beta=20 deg, r=15 deg/s) — the controller will recover it to level altitude-hold on startup.

trim_throttle_notes: feedforward throttle baseline for ~500 ft/s level at 5000 ft; the throttle PI trims around it.

gains.Vref_fps_notes: DI rate loops use pole placement, not dynamic-pressure scheduling; leave 0.
gains.pqr_notes: pole placement: kp=2*zeta*wn, ki=wn^2 (each rate axis is a 1/s integrator after inversion).

vehicle._note: copied verbatim from Flight-Simulator/physics/input_files/F16input.json (mass block + aerodynamics.coefficients). cbar=longitudinal_length, b=lateral_length.
